name: DateJournal: Russian Girls Dating Sim
source:
Have you ever been on a date with a Russian girl? Well, it's about time! Travel to summertime St. Petersburg and meet the beauties in this board game and dating sim mix.

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176890/]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
你可曾与俄罗斯女孩约会过？是时候体验一回了！在这部融合了桌游与恋爱模拟玩法的作品中，前往夏日里的圣彼得堡，邂逅一位位动人的佳人吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176890/]Steam[/url]]
